name: Greater Create Opening
body:
You are skilled at confusing your opponents.

Prerequisite(s): Combat Expertise, Improved Create Opening, base attack bonus +6, Int 13.

Benefit(s): You receive a +2 bonus to your Combat Maneuver Bonus when performing this combat maneuver against a foe. This bonus stacks with the bonus granted by Improved Create Opening. Once per round you can perform a create opening combat maneuver as a swift action.
